decision: keep separate from the exact-width validation and do not submit now
existing_correlation: The observed CIC rate/loading-covariance correlation is descriptive and does not establish that the covariance causes the rate spread.
proposed_modified_loading_study: A PPC scan using nested positions and antithetic per-cell beam/thermal quartets tests convergence of that modified loading scheme. It does not directly explain the spread of the original global-shuffle scheme unless an additional bridge comparison holds PPC and all other settings fixed while changing only the loading construction.
